sentences: A probabilistic query may have an efficiently computable answer probability even when its Boolean lineage has a complicated representation.
The source asks whether tractable probability evaluation necessarily comes with tractable lineages.
The question tests whether a compact reusable explanation is essential to efficient numerical evaluation or merely one common route.
A separation would show that direct probability algorithms can exploit structure missed by the chosen lineage formalism.
